full_sentence: I usually get up at seven o'clock.

options.why_wrong: 'In' is not used before days of the week. We say 'on Sunday'.
We say 'in the morning', not 'on the morning'.
'At' is not used before seasons. We say 'in summer'.

grammar_focus: Prepositions of time with clock times
explanation: Clock times take the preposition 'at'. Ukrainian speakers may choose the wrong preposition because Ukrainian uses different case endings instead of prepositions for time expressions.
translation: Я зазвичай встаю о сьомій годині.
